All four units are in the adjacent group, which is why the unadjusted spillover estimate is the number that moves most. The corrected values take the merged units' shares from their summed vote counts, by the deposited script's own definitions, which return the deposited value for every other unit. The direct effect in Table 3 stays at 0.025 in both models, the pooled estimates in Table 7 stay at 0.017 and 0.015 with standard errors of 0.007 and 0.006, and the paper's conclusions stand.
